cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Who Changed It?
cards.instruction: Ask innocent questions until someone admits altering the plan, schedule, arrangement, or shared space.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I taught you to keep this calendar clear. The picnic's moved to Friday; whose blue pen is that?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you're considering every possibility. Who still adds the little hearts I told you to stop putting round dates?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: All right, I changed it. Friday suits me better.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're finally owning your changes. And who gets to practise the update messages I taught you on the Saturday guests?
